label: At least some expressions require attention to their rule-governed role in a specified practice…
paraphrase: OPEN analyst formulation; attribution DEFERRED: At least some expressions require attention to their rule-governed role in a specified practice for adequate understanding of competent uses; merely identifying a named object does not exhaust what is required. This asserts neither a universal meaning-is-use identity nor that complete sentence-level inference behavior fixes literal reference.
note: Unproved and unestablished. No Lean declaration, source claim or self-evidence marking. The bearing classification and strongest rivals are in docs/wittgenstein.md; existing formal boundaries do not establish this existential philosophical proposition.
